### MaosaicoLayers()

```ts
function MaosaicoLayers(__namedParameters): ReactElement;
```

Mount inside the shell's positioned container, outside clipped panes. Roots are
pointer-transparent; interactive portal content enables pointers. The host
supplies Stipe's stylesheet and retains content and focus ownership.

#### Parameters

| Parameter                      | Type                                                        | Description                                                               |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `__namedParameters`            | \{ `children?`: `ReactNode`; `onDismiss?`: () => `void`; \} | -                                                                         |
| `__namedParameters.children?`  | `ReactNode`                                                 | Host content rendered alongside the overlay roots.                        |
| `__namedParameters.onDismiss?` | () => `void`                                                | Light-dismiss transient overlays on host blur or focus entering a window. |

#### Returns

`ReactElement`
